title: Fukumenkei Noise
synopsis:
Every day, a young girl wearing a mask stands by the beach and sings a nostalgic melody. After experiencing two sudden heart-wrenching partings when she was only a child, Nino Arisugawa has been singing her songs to the ocean, bound by a promise made with her two childhood friends—her first love, Momo Sakaki, and a boy who composed music, Kanade "Yuzu" Yuzuriha. Having never met each other, the boys both individually promised that if Nino was ever separated from them, her voice would be the beacon to reunite them once again.

After six long years, destiny has finally placed Nino, Momo, and Yuzu in the same high school. However, the passage of time has changed many things in their lives—while Nino relentlessly attempts to fulfill her childhood promise with the boys, Yuzu's feelings for her from the past resurface, and Momo goes to great lengths to prevent a reunion with Nino. Through music, will they be able to mend their friendship and overcome all the feelings involved in this complicated love triangle?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Tunshi Xingkong Movie: Jie Shou Weiji

synonyms: Tunshi Xingkong Juchang Ban: Jie Shou Weiji
alternative_titles.ja: 吞噬星空剧场版 界兽危机

synopsis:
Under Morosa's guidance, Luo Feng ventured deeper into the Boundary Beast's lair. In the darkness, his divine power was devoured, and Morosa was hunted for betraying his clan. Luo Feng repelled the encirclement with the Star Tower defense, the Wings of Wu Assassination Blockade, the Golden Claw God for close combat, and the Lie Yuan Technique for suppression. He witnessed the cruel mechanism of the beast devouring evolution—in the end, only a single king would be born. The outer defense lines of the universe were attacked, forcing the humans, crystals, and other races to jointly defend the small universe, while Hong, Thunder God, and Xu Xin stabilized Earth's rear. 

King candidate Bedi appears, stronger and more skilled at manipulating his own kind, mocking Morosa for bowing to "food" and trying to devour it. Luo Feng and Bedi fought head-on, saved Morosa, and promised not to abandon him, causing Luo Feng to shake his devouring instincts for the first time. Bedi commanded the beast horde to launch a final encirclement. Luo Feng changed tactics during extreme exhaustion: Morosa actively distracted the beasts and disrupted Bedi's rhythm. After being severely wounded, Bedi forcibly evolved. Morosa suggested devouring the remnants of his origin himself, and Luo Feng restrained him with the Lieyuan Art and the Bond Mark. Luo Feng suppressed Bedi's origin, and Morosa won the primordial battle in the Storm of Destruction. 

With Bedi's fall and the end of the realm beast calamity, Morosa became the only special realm beast under Luo Feng's command. After the battle, Luo Feng realized that this victory relied on higher civilization legacies such as the Star Tower, Jin World, and Lieyuan Technique. Morosa also sensed that the source of destruction lay far behind. Zuoshanke revealed: All three originate from the Origin Continent, where more complete rules exist, as well as the causality between the Jin and Food Kingdoms. Luo Feng understood that going to the Origin Continent was not about leaving home, but about seeking a true way to protect the human race and the Cosmic Sea. After bidding farewell to Xu Xin, Hong, and Thunder God, he took the Star Tower and Morosa into the Reincarnation Passage, heading to the Origin Continent. 

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Wo de Linju Quan Shi Mao
Renai Boukun
synopsis:
When a strange girl named Guri comes knocking at Seiji Aino's door, he quickly finds himself thrust into a world of romantic troubles. Claiming that she will die if he does not kiss someone within 24 hours, Guri's pleas of desperation are misunderstood as pleas for love, leading Seiji to kiss the cute stranger that came barging into his house. In actuality, it turns out that this cosplaying cupid is the wielder of a Kiss Note, in which any pairing of names she writes will kiss and become a couple. Guri explains that she misspelt and accidentally wrote Seiji's name while indulging in her yaoi fantasies, but because she had yet to pair him with anyone, their kiss was meaningless. Even worse, Guri reveals that if Seiji is not coupled with anyone soon, not only will she die, but Seiji will remain a virgin for eternity!

Eager to escape his fate, Seiji sets his sights on the beautiful and popular Akane Hiyama. But after Akane hears that he kissed Guri, she reveals the obsessive and psychopathic feelings that she holds for the unfortunate boy and proceeds to viciously attack them. In the ensuing confusion, Guri is able to pair Seiji with Akane in the Kiss Note, temporarily saving Seiji from any further bodily harm. But to complicate matters, Guri's newfound feelings lead her to also pair the two of them with herself. Just when the situation could not get any more convoluted, this new coupling with Guri has turned Seiji and Akane into temporary angels, forcing them into assisting the cupid with her work of pairing humans, lest they be cast into hell. With all semblance of normality snatched from his life, Seiji gets to work at matchmaking with these eccentric girls by his side.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Aru Nihon no Ekaki Shounen

alternative_titles.ja: ある日本の絵描き少年

synopsis:
Ever since he was old enough to hold a crayon, Shinji has loved drawing and has dreamed of becoming a manga artist. When he starts attending school, the only other student who shares his passion is Masaru, who draws people he cares about as luchador wrestlers. As the two grow up, Shinji struggles to hone his skills but Masaru never moves away from his childish style.

When Shinji finally moves to Tokyo to chase his dreams, he finds that the road ahead is incredibly difficult and struggles to make a mark on the industry. As Shinji grows increasingly jaded, his childhood friend might just be able to show him that there is more to art than financial success.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
